tactics:
induction l with
  | nil => intro acc; simp [List.filterMapM.loop]
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro acc
    simp only [List.filterMapM.loop, map_bind]
    congr 1
    funext x
    cases x with
    | none => simp [ih (acc := acc)]
    | some b => simp [ih (acc := b :: acc), ih (acc := [b])]

induction l with
  | nil => intro acc; simp [List.filterMapM.loop]
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro acc
    simp only [List.filterMapM.loop, map_bind]
    apply bind_congr
    intro x
    cases x with
    | none => simp [ih (acc := acc)]
    | some b => simp [ih (acc := b :: acc), ih (acc := [b]), Functor.map_map]
